verdict.rationale: Self-hosting is a fair question for business accounting software, so the axis applies. However, the evidence only describes QuickBooks Online as an Intuit-hosted cloud service. The locally runnable MCP server and SDKs are integration building blocks rather than a self-hosted core product, and the community mention of hosted desktop QuickBooks concerns a different product run by a third party.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
